question: What was ordered quantity per order for the full year 2025? Use the recorded order date for the 2025 scope.

metric_definitions.ordered_quantity_per_order: Ordered item quantity divided by number of orders; combines both fact semantic models.

action.answer: For orders with recorded order dates from 2025-01-01 through 2025-12-31, ordered quantity per order was 2.805393 items per order. This is total ordered item quantity divided by total orders, regardless of order status.

final_answer: For orders with recorded order dates from 2025-01-01 through 2025-12-31, ordered quantity per order was 2.805393 items per order. This is total ordered item quantity divided by total orders, regardless of order status.
